en: A vintage two-panel postcard. The upper image shows a panoramic view of a valley town with hills in the background and a large rectangular Baroque-style building with corner towers in the foreground. Above it is printed the German caption "Gruß aus Eggenberg bei Graz." The lower image shows a village street scene with several people in traditional clothing standing on a curved road between plastered houses with tiled roofs. A caption above this lower view reads "Anton Suppan's Gasthaus 'zur Alpe.'" The overall print is in monochrome/sepia, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
